steps.title: 2 · Take the payment

faqs.title: How do I get paid?
faqs.body: A commission on every upgrade you close, recorded against your code the moment the sale goes through. We settle with you by transfer or in cash, and we set your rate with you when you are approved.

faqs.title: Do I need to sell technology?
faqs.body: No. You are selling a business a better address and a wider reach. The store itself takes minutes, and the merchant types nothing.

faqs.title: Is it really 0% commission for the merchant?
faqs.body: Yes. We take no cut of their sales, ever. They pay their own payment processor exactly as they would anywhere, and that money lands in their own account.

faqs.title: Then how does Miyagi make money?
faqs.body: From the premium upgrades — domains, migrations and placement. Never a cut of a sale that a merchant made.

faqs.title: What territory do I get?
faqs.body: The businesses you can reach. Tell us where you work when you apply and we will settle it with you before you start.
